parts.title: Turn work into career evidence
parts.body: Prepare a concise strategy memo, board briefing, architecture diagram, governance record, value scorecard, and leadership stories. Explain what you personally decided, what others owned, and what changed as a result. Label hypothetical capstone work clearly so it cannot be mistaken for a shipped company outcome.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Practice the interview
parts.body: Choose six stories across strategy, investment, cross-functional conflict, technical judgment, risk response, and organizational change. For each, write the situation, your decision, evidence used, result, and what you would do differently. Rehearse a two-minute version and a deeper follow-up.
parts.label: Apply
